_comment: Catalog whitelist for MarshallBuilder's prepare_workspace tool — ported from projects/marshall-cli/config/repo-map.yml (JSON here since the MCP server is zero-dependency, no YAML parser). Keep in sync until marshall-cli is decommissioned (plan Phase 4); this is the one duplication that migration knowingly accepts rather than adding a YAML dependency for.

pp-hub.description: Central hub for Partner Programmer's internal dashboards and ClickUp automations. Next.js 16 + Prisma + Neon Postgres, deployed on Vercel.

marshall-assistant.description: Marshall's own versionable recipe (this project) — skills, persona, config, install/apply scripts for the NanoClaw v2 instance.

breez-hub.description: Breez's real-time sync platform connecting WooCommerce orders to HubSpot CRM. Next.js 16 + Prisma + Supabase Postgres, deployed on Vercel.

breez-website.description: Breez's main WordPress/WooCommerce e-commerce platform for student rentals. PHP, Vite, React. Deployed via GitHub Actions to Cloudways.

breez-hubspot-app.description: HubSpot Developer Project — single source of truth for Breez's HubSpot CRM configuration (custom properties, pipelines) and the help-center CMS theme. HubSpot CLI, TypeScript, HubL.

breez-ai-agent.description: Documentation and configuration for "Breeze", Breez's HubSpot AI customer support agent.

logistics-app.description: Breez's delivery/logistics dashboard (MyFridgeRentalWeb), vendored read-only from a repo Breez's own logistics developer owns (not PP). Context only — never an implement target.

logistics-mobile-app.description: Flutter mobile app for Breez's field logistics operations (order management, signature capture, customer messaging). Releases cut from this repo's `staging` branch, not `main` — check before opening a PR.

knowledge-base-faq.description: Structured FAQ data (JSON) for Breez customer support channels, used by the Breeze AI agent and support team.

knowledge-base-articles.description: Detailed help articles and guides (Markdown) for Breez customers, used by the Breeze AI agent and support team.

pp-stack.description: Partner Programmer's shared Claude Code skills package (this is Marshall's own /story, /report-issue, /work, /pp-slack-update, /pp-auto-pilot, /pp-review-pack, etc.) — standalone repo, not part of pp-brain or breez-brain. CAUTION: this repo's dev checkout doubles as the live install at ~/.claude/skills/pp-stack on every PP developer's machine — a change here affects every Claude Code session on the machine the moment it lands on main, not just after a deploy. Treat with the same care as touching shared infra.
